name: Direct Diffuse Lighting with Shadow Maps
aliases: Direct Diffuse Light Calculation with Shadow Maps
Lambertian Diffuse with Shadow Map Visibility
definition: Calculates direct diffuse lighting using the Lambertian model and a shadow map to determine visibility. The shadow map is rendered from the light source's point of view, and a depth test compares fragments from the camera's point of view against the shadow map to determine if they are visible to the light.
